title: Yelp Review Bias Detection (FairwAI)
description: Analyzed 109,000+ Yelp reviews across 16,000+ businesses in Philadelphia, Tampa, and Indianapolis. Found a 0.63-star cuisine rating gap, neighborhood disparities, and signs of retaliatory reviewing.

title: Fuel Economy Data Visualization
description: Analyzed 398 vehicle records using Python and Seaborn to identify how weight, engine power, region, and model year affect fuel efficiency. Heavier vehicles averaged up to 30% lower MPG.

title: Art Across Borders
description: Used SQL joins, subqueries, and aggregations across 50+ museums and 20+ art styles. Found Impressionism dominated the Met's holdings at 244+ works.

title: Movie Profitability: Revenue vs. Budget
description: Pivot tables and statistical analysis of movie budgets vs. box office revenue by genre and rating.

title: COVID-19 Impact on Food Consumption
description: Interactive dashboard analyzing global food consumption shifts during COVID-19 across demographics.

title: Adventure Works
description: Interactive dashboard analyzing sales and profit trends by product, category, and region for executive-level reporting.
